big_case.notes: Paid state postconviction petition asking whether a detective may relay an absent three-year-old complainant's accusation as non-hearsay 'background' and the prosecution then use it as proof of guilt. The question recurs in criminal trials and sits under Smith v. Arizona, but this vehicle is an unpublished Kansas Court of Appeals 60-1507 ruling resting partly on Strickland prejudice, with no response filed and no institutional or public salience beyond the criminal bar. It was denied at its first conference with no noted dissent.
